Line under the chart in the HISTORY card. %1$s is the battery at the start and end of the last charge
         ("42% → 90%", stats_charge_battery_span), %2$s how long it took ("2 h 10 min", stats_charge_duration_*).
The same when the last charge's length is not known: %1$s is the battery at its start and end ("42% → 90%").
Label above the card linking to Assists and Speed limits. Shown in capitals.
